description: This source file defines the Cell class in the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel.Tables namespace, representing a cell in a table within a document. It includes properties and methods for managing cell formatting, content elements, merging, and serialization.

classes.name: Cell
classes.description: Represents a cell in a table and provides properties and methods for cell content, formatting, merging, and serialization.

classes.name: Cell.CellValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for the Cell class.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the cell object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy operation, also cloning nested objects like format, borders, shading, and elements.

methods.name: ResetCachedValues
methods.description: Resets cached references to related objects such as row, column, and table.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph element to the cell.

methods.name: AddChart
methods.description: Adds a chart to the cell, optionally specifying the chart type.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image to the cell.

methods.name: AddTextFrame
methods.description: Adds a text frame to the cell.

methods.name: Add (Paragraph)
methods.description: Adds an existing paragraph to the cell.

methods.name: Add (Chart)
methods.description: Adds an existing chart to the cell.

methods.name: Add (Image)
methods.description: Adds an existing image to the cell.

methods.name: Add (TextFrame)
methods.description: Adds an existing text frame to the cell.
